===== What This Wiki Is =====
This is the main MetaDyn operating wiki: company context, platform architecture, Unity 6 SDK documentation, infrastructure maps, CRM/ops dashboards, and long-lived working knowledge.

**MetaDyn** — short for **Metaverse Dynamix** — is building a next-generation digital fabric connecting people, places, and things through immersive experiences, persistent identity, and intelligent systems.
